chunks: The Shaykh Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babawayh al-Qummi (rh) narrated to us [...] from Jabir b. Abdullah al-Ansari. He said:

I have heard the Messenger of God (s) describe the characteristics of Ali -- if only one were among all people, they would suffice as virtue: 'Whoever I am his master, Ali is his master.' 'Ali to me is as Harun was to Musa.' 'Ali is from me and I from him.' 'Ali is like myself; obedience to him is obedience to me.' 'The war of Ali is the war of God.' 'The friend of Ali is the friend of God.' 'Ali is the Proof of God and His vicegerent over His servants.'

key_terms.حُجَّةُ اللَّهِ: Proof of God - divine appointment as guide
key_terms.كَهَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَى: Like Harun to Musa - Aaron's position with Moses

ai.seo_question: What are the seven virtues of Imam Ali mentioned by Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated by the prominent companion Jabir b. Abdullah al-Ansari, compiles seven celebrated prophetic statements about Imam Ali (as). Each establishes a dimension of Ali's unique spiritual and political authority: the Ghadir declaration, his likeness to Harun, his identity with the Prophet, obedience/disobedience, war and peace, friendship/enmity with God, and his role as God's Proof and vicegerent. This is a foundational creedal text in Shia theology regarding the Imamate.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. a-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. al-Hasan al-Mu’addab narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. `Ali al-Isfahani narrated to us from Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Ja`far b. al-Hasan narrated to us from `Ubaydullah b. Musa al-`Abbasi from Muhammad b. `Ali al-Salami from `Abdullah b. Muhammad b. `Aqil from Jabir b. `Abdullah al-Ansari.

He said: I have heard the Messenger of Allah (s) describe the characteristics of `Ali – if only one were spread among all the people, they would have sufficient virtue. He (s) said: “For whomever I am a master, `Ali is his master.” He (s) said: “`Ali to me is as Harun was to Musa.” He (s) said: “`Ali is from me and I am from him.” He (s) said: “`Ali is from me like my own self. Obedience to him is obedience to me, and disobedience to him is disobedience to me.” He (s) said: “The war of `Ali is the war of Allah, and the peace of `Ali is the peace of Allah.” He (s) said: “The friend of `Ali is the friend of Allah, and the enemy of `Ali is the enemy of Allah.” He (s) said: “`Ali is the Proof of Allah and His vicegerent over His servants.”
